candidates.description: This feature vector represents military aggression, conflict, and hostile territorial takeover.
This feature vector represents 20th-century political ideologies, totalitarian regimes, and major historical conflicts, particularly those related to communism, fascism, and World War II.
This feature vector activates on words related to explosive warfare, attacks, and weaponry.
This vector represents deliberate plans of action or methods used to achieve specific goals.
This feature activates on words related to sociopolitical categorization, governmental periods, or foreign-language grammatical articles and prepositions.
This feature represents past-tense active verbs denoting specific historical or narrative actions.
This vector represents armed forces, military personnel, and warfare-related concepts across multiple languages.
This vector represents degree, quantity, or intensity modifiers across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents logical transition, consequence, or sequential connectors across multiple languages.
This vector activates for words and terms related to Japan, Japanese culture, and East Asian geography.
